court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Gautam Budh Nagar - Case No. 1326 of 2019
case_name: Smt. Shakshi Agrawal vs Sri Ashutosh Agrawal
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties are an estranged couple who were married in 2019. The applicant stayed with the opposite party initially but complaints of cruelty and physical violence appeared early into the marriage. The applicant seeks to transfer a petition for annulment from Gautam Budh Nagar to Allahabad.

legal_principles.principle: It is in the interests of both parties that all their cases be heard together by the same Court.
legal_principles.held: As per the submission of the appellant, two cases are already pending in Family Court, Bhopal, and it will be in the interests of both the parties to try all their cases in Bhopal. Learned counsel for the respondent, however, submits that it will suit to the appellant only, therefore, transfer may not be permitted.
cited_cases: a Singh Chouhan vs. Vishal Singh Chouhan, 2019 (13) SCC 660

legal_principles.principle: The transfer petition may be allowed if the respondent is already appearing in the same court for other pending cases.
legal_principles.held: It is stated that the respondent husband is already appearing in Dungarpur Court, Rajasthan in connection with the aforesaid cases instituted by the petitioner wife and that it may not be difficult for the respondent husband to pursue the divorce petition in Dungarpur Court, Rajasthan.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
cited_cases: Smt. Shakshi Agrawal vs Sri Ashutosh Agrawal on 4 February, 2022

outcome.final_order: The application for transfer is allowed and the case is transferred from Principal Judge, Family Court, Gautam Budh Nagar to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Allahabad.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
Latin maxim: Actus non facit reum nisi mens sit rea
